stories.headline: Google's Gemini can now call businesses and buy things for you
stories.blurb: Google is rolling out Tasks mode to hundreds of millions of users for free. Flip a toggle in the Gemini app and it can call to book appointments, make purchases through Google Pay, and log into websites on your behalf. One exec used it to call car dealerships for a service appointment.
stories.why_it_matters: Your phone's AI assistant just became something that can actually do errands instead of just answering questions.
stories.original_headline: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases

stories.headline: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B to take AI-designed drugs into human trials
stories.blurb: The DeepMind spinoff that uses AI to design drugs just raised $5 billion from Sequoia, a16z, and others. The company says its AI models have produced drugs with 'positive preclinical results' in cancer and immune diseases, and it's now moving toward clinical trials. Founded by Nobel laureate Demis Hassabis, Isomorphic has deals with Eli Lilly, Novartis, and J&J.
stories.why_it_matters: AI-designed drugs are about to be tested in humans for the first time at scale.
stories.original_headline: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B as it looks to take drug candidates to clinical trials

stories.headline: Robotics startup Genesis AI raises $500M to build general-purpose robots
stories.blurb: Genesis AI just closed a $500 million round to build what CEO Zhou Xian calls 'the world's best general-purpose robot.' The startup is betting on AI-powered robots that can handle multiple tasks rather than single-purpose machines.
stories.why_it_matters: Half a billion dollars signals serious investor belief that robotics is ready to move beyond narrow factory tasks.
stories.original_headline: Genesis AI, a Robotics Startup, Raises $500 Million

stories.headline: Microsoft just shipped two coding models that cost half what GPT-4 does
stories.blurb: MAI Code 2 handles production debugging, multi-file edits, and repo-wide reasoning at 40% the cost of GPT-4o while delivering 98% of its performance on everyday coding tasks. Code 2 Flash is even cheaper for high-volume work like code explanations and routine fixes. Both are tuned for the work developers actually do in GitHub Copilot, not research or long-horizon agent tasks.
stories.why_it_matters: Production-quality code assistance just became affordable enough to run on every pull request.

stories.headline: NVIDIA's new Vera Rubin chip trains AI agents twice as fast per GPU
stories.blurb: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform swept every MLPerf training benchmark in its debut, delivering 2x performance per GPU over the previous generation and 10x better efficiency for agentic AI workloads. The chip scaled nearly perfectly from 256 to 1,024 GPUs, cutting training time from 16 minutes to 4 minutes on DeepSeek-V3.
stories.why_it_matters: Faster training means smarter AI agents reach production weeks sooner and adapt to new data in real time.
stories.original_headline: NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance
